title: CoANeRV shared coordinate decoder with factorized video/time/region Mirror codes
hypothesis: For a small video library sharing one CoANeRV-style coordinate-conditioned decoder, a product-factor Mirror code over video x temporal-token-role x spatial-region can replace much of each full per-video token bank while preserving reconstruction quality and query throughput, and can improve the quality/bytes frontier over low-rank or additive token-code controls.
physical_object: One shared frozen coordinate-query cross-attention decoder and shared code-generator state; each video is represented by a video-specific token bank or a compact code that generates it.
mirror_coordinate: For token slot i=(time_role t, spatial_region r), h_i=(m_video P_v) elementwise-multiplied by (E_t P_t) and (E_r P_r); token T_i=h_i D. Time/region tables and projections are shared; m_video is the per-video code.
logical_multiplicity: Per-video continuous RGB video reconstruction functions queried at arbitrary (x,y,t) coordinates; the factor code is evaluated for every video-token slot.

upstream.direct_control: Paper Appendix A.5 / Table 7: freeze shared coordinate decoder and optimize only each video token bank.

controls: Native CoANeRV decoder-only control: full independent N x d learned token bank per video, shared decoder frozen during per-video fitting.
Shared low-rank token dictionary control: rank-r code per video over a common learned token-slot basis.
Additive factor code: video + temporal-role + spatial-region projected embeddings decoded to token vectors.
Mirror product-factor code, using the same factor tables and code width as additive control.
Mirror product code plus rank-2 private token residual dictionary.

data.source: Xiph/Derf standard Y4M test sequences from https://media.xiph.org/video/derf/y4m/
data.decode: first 8 consecutive frames; center-crop 176x144 QCIF to 144x144 then bicubic resize to 64x64 RGB in [0,1]. Preserve source file SHA-256 and exact Y4M parser/frame offsets.
data.pixel_split: Within each 8-frame development/fresh clip, deterministic 80% coordinate train / 20% coordinate evaluation split from SHA256(seed, frame, x, y); all times and spatial regions appear in train and evaluation. No frame is fully withheld because native CoANeRV encoder sees the complete clip.
data.source_data_license_scope: Public video test sequences used only for this local research screen; source clips are not committed.

model.decoder: Reduced CoANeRV coordinate-decoder core: axis-adaptive (x,y,t) Fourier embedding, temperature-scaled cross-attention to video tokens (tau=0.4), and a shared 2-layer RGB MLP. This is not the full convolutional tokenizer/six-layer token former/384x72 paper system.
model.role_mapping: Fixed token index order: i=4*t+r, t in 0..7, r in 0..3; spatial regions are the 2x2 image quadrants.
model.optimizer: Adam, lr=0.001; fixed across methods and seeds; no decay or scheduler.
model.shared_generator_fit_optimizer: Adam, lr=0.001, fit against decoder-trained source token banks
model.rng_scheme: torch.manual_seed(base_seed) before shared decoder; seed+100+video_index for source sample RNG; seed+100+rank+method_id for factor generator; seed+500+dev_clip_index+method_id+rank for per-video code initialization; explicit Generator(seed-derived) for coordinate sampling.

development.selection_metric: All predeclared quality, complete-payload, marginal-code, compute/runtime, and simple-control gates at the best eligible Mirror rank.
development.allowed_tuning: Only Mirror/additive/low-rank rank in {2,4,8}. Training updates, decoder architecture, data split, optimizer, model size, and thresholds are fixed.

fresh.methods: Selected Mirror rank, full-token native control, byte-near low-rank/additive controls, and Mirror+private rank-2; no exclusions after fresh access.

storage.authority: actual serialized inference payload bytes from torch.save
storage.single_video_payload: Shared decoder plus shared code generator (if present), one video code/token state, and metadata.
storage.library_payload: One shared decoder/generator object plus all per-video token/code entries for K=1 or K=2 real clips; no decoder duplication across the library.
paid_objects: every video-specific full token table or Mirror/additive/low-rank code
private residual dictionary and per-video residual codes
factor-role mapping, precision, architecture, and serialization metadata
metrics: serialized payload bits per reconstructed RGB pixel (neural-payload bpp; not conventional codec bpp)

compute.active_compute: Report coordinate-query attention and MLP MACs per pixel; token-code generation MACs per video and per token; per-video fitting MAC proxy.
compute.runtime: CPU only, OMP/MKL threads=1; measure decoder training, per-video code fitting, token generation, full reconstruction wall time and random-query pixels/second.
compute.memory: Report peak process RSS and explicit peak attention-logit tensor bytes. No GPU/energy extrapolation.

development_gate: A single rank must satisfy on BOTH dev clips and BOTH seeds: (1) product-Mirror PSNR no more than 1.0 dB below native full-token control; (2) SSIM no more than 0.03 below native; (3) K=2 complete library serialized payload <=0.95x native full-token library payload and marginal per-video state <=0.50x native token table; (4) query throughput >=0.50x native full-token decoder. To support a Mirror-specific result, at K=2 bytes within 10%, Mirror must also exceed the best low-rank/additive control by at least 0.30 dB average PSNR. If the general gate passes but the last clause fails, report no Mirror-specific advantage.
success_gate: Freeze the smallest rank passing all development clauses. On all three fresh clips and both fresh seeds, retain the same quality, storage, throughput, and matched-simple-control gates. Fresh only replicates the frozen configuration.
failure_gate: No rank passes the complete development gate on both development clips and seeds; record FAIL and do not access fresh clips. A fresh gate miss also yields FAIL.
boundaries: Reduced CoANeRV coordinate-decoder mechanism screen, not a full CoANeRV reproduction or official Kinetics/UVG rate-distortion result.
The full feed-forward video tokenizer/token former is not implemented; the native baseline is the paper’s decoder-only per-video token optimization ablation.
Neural-payload bpp is not an entropy-coded conventional video bitstream rate.
Fixed-update results do not establish near-converged capacity.
CPU measurements do not establish GPU/FPS/energy gains.
Fresh video files are not downloaded/opened unless development gate passes.
